Residuo o recidiva di glioma a basso gra: Non-enhancing low-grade glioma residue or recurrence around the surgical cavity
Dopo l'intervento per un glioma a basso:
After surgery for a non-enhancing low-grade glioma, residual or recurrent tumour appears as ill-defined T2 and FLAIR hyperintensity around the cavity: always compare with the previous scan. Gliosis is thinner and more regular along the cavity margins and does not grow over time. New nodular enhancement or rapid growth suggests transformation towards a higher grade: here there is no enhancement.
In the report: extent relative to the cavity, nearby functional sites (insula, operculum, internal capsule), enhancement, comparison with the previous follow-up.
Glioma a basso grado operato: segui la F: Operated low-grade glioma: follow the FLAIR around the cavity and look for new enhancement.
